title: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-34 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in its -morph processing, where crafted images cause…
description: ImageMagick versions before 7.1.2-34 have a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the -morph image processing feature. This flaw allows crafted images to cause writes beyond the bounds of a heap buffer, potentially crashing the application when processed with the -morph option.
